newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-NEW YEAR'S DAY PROGRAMME LIKELY AS STRIKE THREAT WANES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEW YEAR'S DAY PROGRAMME LIKELY AS STRIKE THREAT WANES.

text.p: Spanish crowds may be treated to a full first division programme on New Year's Day after the country's league and players' association agreed in principle to move games originally scheduled for December 29.
Players unhappy at losing their traditional Christmas break had threatened to strike if the games were not postponed but had asked for them to be put off to a date later in January.

In recent years the Spanish league has closed down from before Christmas until after New Year. But a calendar already bloated by an expanded European calendar and World Cup qualifiers has been stretched further to accomodate the 22-team first division that arose from a legal bungle in 1995.
Thursday's agreement must be ratified by the assemblies of both Spain's Professional Football Association and Association of Professional Footballers.
